examples.text: 1912, Martin Luther, Lutherbibel von 1912, Jeremiah 42:10 (with KJV translation)
examples.translation: If ye will still abide in this land, then will I build you, and not pull you down, and I will plant you, and not pluck you up: for I repent me of the evil that I have done unto you.
examples.english: If ye will still abide in this land, then will I build you, and not pull you down, and I will plant you, and not pluck you up: for I repent me of the evil that I have done unto you.
